adjudication.rationale: The diff shows duplicated logic to resolve the “embed author” user from the `embed_by_username` setting: `user = User.where(username_lower: SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase).first` appears in `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:26-27) and in `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` (lib/topic_retriever.rb:50-52). In both places, if no matching user is found, the method simply `return`s (PollFeed: `return if user.blank?`; TopicRetriever: `return if user.blank?`) with no logging/exception, so a misconfiguration causes silent no-op behavior. This is a real, diff-grounded maintainability/operability issue, but not a strictly verifiable functional defect.
